title: Tenma Saki — The Feelings We've Realized〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I told Shiho that I want to see what I'm capable of, but songwriting's turning out to be so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I am trying to take a look at this from a couple different angles...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But none of the melodies or riffs that I've come up with so far felt right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I want to help our band by contributing to our music somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Saki. There you are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa, it's you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I came to ask if you had already tried any of the fruit jellies that were in the freezer.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... Mom told me about them earlier. I think I'll pass for now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Is something bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I know! The one you were looking for wasn't there! It's no wonder you seem so down, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? I don't really feel all that sad or anything...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why not just try a different flavor? You never know, it could be good!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Take myself for example. I tried a grapefruit-flavored one just now even though I'm not exactly a fan of them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa, I'm in high school now! I'm not a little kid that gets all pouty over something like jellies anymore...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? If you say so.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then tell me, why do you seem so down? Remember, you can talk to your magnificent big brother about anything!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Says you, oh magnificent one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you know, I think I'll take you up on your offer.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Lately, the girls and I have been talking about coming up with an original song for our band...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: An original song! That's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, and I was convinced that it'd be super fun and stuff at first...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I even decided that I'd contribute by helping write songs for the band...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it hasn't been going well at all...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And even though I know how to play the piano, it feels like I haven't been able to fit it into our music at all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I keep asking myself what it would be like if I could just play a little better...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not sure I can answer that question for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, being able to play the piano doesn't automatically mean you'll know how to write songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! Didn't you and Toya used to play the piano together when we were kids?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, you mean when we played at the same time?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I remember you wanting to see who could play it the most freely or something, and really banging away at the keys.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your description isn't doing it any justice. There was definitely a certain kind of melody or rhythm we were playing to...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? I totally felt like Toya was doing all the work while you goofed off.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: L-Look who's talking! Didn't you jump in right after that and cause an even bigger racket?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I was just copying what you were doing! I wasn't fooling around like you were, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But in the end, Toya just kept at it to try and make whatever musical mess we were making work.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Looking back, I feel a little bad for him, but then again, we all seemed to be having a good time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Maybe that's it. Maybe I just have to let myself go a little more...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Saki...
Is it tough being in a band?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?!
No, it's not what you think!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I am having so much fun playing and performing with everyone! I love every minute of it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I want to do more to help our band grow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why... I know things won't go well in the beginning, but I want to do what I can.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So it is tough in that sense... But I feel like it's just something I have to deal with for now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. Good for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're doing what you love and properly committing yourself to it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And ultimately, all good things must come to an end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I... No, the others and I have some experience with that too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You do...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We fail and put everyone's efforts to waste... And even when we propose to create something good, they don't feel the same...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Or even when we haven't changed, our surroundings change and let ourselves get lonely...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We become so obsessed with our own dreams and full of pride that we end up hurting the people close to us...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So you had a tough time too, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why are you apologizing? This is exactly the same as that tough hurdle you just mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And don't worry, it's all in the past now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We overcame that and are putting on outrageous shows even today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Is it really okay to call your own shows outrageous, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Outrageous, unique, one of a kind! They're all compliments in my book!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha. My brother the optimist.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I get what you're trying to say. It's not all fun and games...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have to be willing to put everything on the line to become a pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you say for sure that you'd be able to do that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Shiho knew that from the start. She knew that we'd face something like this...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought about it for a really long time and still felt that I want to be in a band with you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I spent so much time worrying about what would happen...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But I still ended up deciding to try and go pro with Shiho!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I shouldn't be hesitating like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa, I'm heading back up to my room! I'm gonna write this song no matter what it takes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's great, Saki!
Do your best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! I will!
